content_sections.heading: About JAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The posts are at the Agricultural Research Station of Junagadh Agricultural University, Keria Road, Amreli, Gujarat, and the notice is issued by the station's Research Scientist (Plant Breeding), Dr. V.N. Gohil. The posts are for the project "National Mission on High Yielding Seeds, B.H. 2008-23", funded by ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi through ICAR-IIOR, Hyderabad. The notice states that the project period is five year.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is marked with an asterisk, and the notice adds that the degree programme must be completed from an ICAR/UGC recognized University/Institute. Desirable qualifications: Experience in Sesame Breeding. Working knowledge of computers, practical knowledge on molecular work and data analysis. The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in Gujarati, Hindi and English. The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for the 1st and 2nd year and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for the 3rd year onward (Fixed). The upper age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. Desirable qualifications: Basic knowledge of computers (MS Office). Hands on experience of working on Molecular markers, Emasculation and pollination work. Ability to read, write and speak in Gujarati, Hindi and English. The pay is a fixed Rs. 30,000 per month, and the age limit is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 45 years, with relaxation as per rules. Desirable qualifications: Experiance of field work like Agricultural experimentation, observation recording as well as computer work/ microsoft office. Preference will be given to graduate in Agriculture. The pay is a fixed Rs. 22,500 per month, and the age limit is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 45 years, with relaxation as per rules. Relaxation in the age limit for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be as per Government of India rules. The application form asks for the candidate's age on 10/12/2026 and for experience as on 10/12/2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The duly filled in application form (the form is printed on page 3 of the notice). Original documents. One passport size photograph; the form asks for a recent passport size duly signed photograph to be affixed on it. One set of photocopies of related documents. No objection certificate from the employer and experience certificate in original, if applicable. Documentary proof of experience with salary drawn, and a certificate for knowledge of computer, as the application form asks. Candidates who do not bring the original documents, the filled form, the photograph and the photocopies shall not be allowed to appear in the interview. The application form asks for: full name, postal address, mobile number, e-mail, date of birth, age on 10/12/2026, gender, category (SC/ST/OBC/General), educational qualification (Graduation, Post graduation, Ph.D., NET – university, passing year, subject, OGPA/percentage), medals and awards, experience, publications, seminars and trainings attended, other activities, knowledge of Gujarati language (SSC/HSC passed with Gujarati subject), knowledge of computer and present status.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the Agricultural Research Station, Junagadh Agricultural University, Amreli on 10 December 2026 by 9:00 AM. If the number of candidates is more, a written screening test will be conducted before the interview. The interview committee reserves all rights to reject any or all candidates. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The positions are purely on a temporary basis and co-terminus with the project, from the date of joining to 31 March 2027. There is no provision for re-employment after termination of the project. Selected candidates can be discontinued owing to administrative reasons at any time by issue of one week's notice. Appointees may also leave the assignment on their own by giving one week's notice. At the end of the contract period, the appointee has no right to claim any employment or engagement in JAU. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. Contact as printed on the notice: Phone (02792) 222247 (O), Email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the JAU Amreli walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026, and candidates must be available by 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the JAU walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Agricultural Research Station, Junagadh Agricultural University, Amreli, whose address is Keria Road, Amreli – 365 601 (Gujarat).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in JAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow, 1 Young Professional-I and 2 Field Workers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Genetics/Plant Breeding/ Genetics and Plant Breeding with 4/5 years bachelor's degree, completed from an ICAR/UGC recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Young Professional-I and Field Worker?
faq.answer: Young Professional-I needs a Graduation degree in Agricultural Science or Diploma in Agricultural Sciences and Equivalent; Field Worker needs a Graduate degree in any discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For the Senior Research Fellow, the upper age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women; for Young Professional-I and Field Worker, it is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 45 years, with relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for the 1st and 2nd year and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA from the 3rd year onward; Young Professional-I gets Rs. 30,000 fixed per month; Field Worker gets Rs. 22,500 fixed per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA is paid on top of the pay only for the Senior Research Fellow; the Young Professional-I and Field Worker pay is fixed per month.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be brought to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents, the duly filled application form, one passport size photograph and one set of photocopies, plus an NOC from the employer and original experience certificate if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected, and how long is the job?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview, with a written screening test if the number of candidates is more; the job is temporary and co-terminus with the project, from the date of joining to 31 March 2027.
